task.description:
IMPLEMENT ISS-201: Change transition() to return TransitionResult{state, emitted_events} per src/design/iss-201-transition-result.md.

CHECKLIST (follow in order):

A. transition.zig changes:
   1. Add TransitionResult struct: pub const TransitionResult = struct { state: InstanceState, emitted_events: []PendingEvent };
   2. Remove pending_events field from InstanceState (line 96). Do NOT touch other fields.
   3. Change signature L156: pub fn transition(...) TransitionError!TransitionResult
   4. All internal pending_events accumulators now collect into emitted_events. At the end return TransitionResult{ .state = new_state, .emitted_events = ... }.
   5. Every return site in transition.zig that currently returns new_state must now wrap it: return TransitionResult{ .state = new_state, .emitted_events = &[0_]PendingEvent{} } (for returns with no events) or with the accumulated events.
   6. Internal transition() calls (processNodeEntry recursion) pass through TransitionResult — decide whether to collect emitted_events from recursive calls.

B. instance.zig changes:
   7. All 5 callers at L689, L888, L1525, L2984, L3091: destructure const result = transition_mod.transition(...) catch ...; const new_state = result.state; const emitted_events = result.emitted_events;
   8. freeOwnedTransitionState() L392-423: change signature to accept TransitionResult. Free result.emitted_events in addition to result.state.* fields.
   9. persistTimersFromPendingEventsInTx() L3580: change first param to accept []PendingEvent (or TransitionResult). You're now passing result.emitted_events instead of state.pending_events.
   10. startSubProcessesForPendingEventsInTx() L3661: update to receive emitted_events from result instead of state.pending_events.
   11. All state literals that set .pending_events = &.{} — remove that field (it's no longer in InstanceState).

C. reconstruction.zig changes:
   12. Replay callers at L210, L322: destructure result.state for the next iteration; optionally collect result.emitted_events for logging/assertion.
   13. Initial state literals: remove .pending_events field.

D. Test file changes (destructuring pattern everywhere):
   14. tests/unit/test_engine_apply.zig — 5 call sites (L76,114,170,207,245)
   15. tests/unit/test_engine_ee05.zig — 9 call sites (L74,115,154,192,229,278,320,362,402)
   16. tests/unit/test_ee07_parallel_join.zig — 3 call sites (L106,125,139)
   17. tests/unit/service_task_test.zig — 1 call site (L384)
   18. Any state literals in tests that reference .pending_events — remove the field.
   19. Any tests within transition.zig itself (test blocks at bottom of file) — update destructuring.

HARD RULES:
- Engine MUST stay pure: zero I/O in transition.zig
- transition() MUST NOT re-append the trigger event — the input event is NOT in emitted_events
- Every existing test must pass with the new signature (same behavior, just destructured)
- zig build && zig build test must exit 0 with NO 'error set' output
- zig build 2>&1 | grep -i 'error set' → empty

Commit and push: git commit -m 'feat(ISS-201): make transition() return TransitionResult{state,emitted_events}'
acceptance_criteria: ALL callers in instance.zig (5), reconstruction.zig (2), unit tests (18+) updated
Engine remains pure (no I/O, no trigger re-append)
zig build exits 0 with NO error-set output
zig build test exits 0 (all existing tests pass with new signature)

result.summary: Implemented ISS-201: transition() now returns TransitionResult{state, emitted_events}. pending_events removed from InstanceState. All 7 source files updated: transition.zig (core), instance.zig (5 callers + freeOwnedTransitionState + persistTimers + startSubProcesses), reconstruction.zig (2 replays), and 4 test files (18 call sites). Build passes, error-set check clean, all 531 tests pass. No migrations required.
